summary.text: Golden Sun Spear is an immortal killer move Zhao Lian Yun uses on Snowy Mountain. A fire staff absorbs golden light and becomes a short crimson-golden spear that explodes like a small sun.

claims.text: On the tenth snowy peak, while fighting Zhao Pu, Zhao Lian Yun spends immortal essence preparing successive immortal killer moves under Spirit Affinity House and Heavenly Court training methods meant for beginners. After interference from Zhao Pu, she continues attempting a third move and forms a chain of fire in her right palm that inflates as she keeps spitting fire.

The fire staff completely absorbs golden light. That light moves inside the staff and stops at the head, gradually turning into a sharp spear, so the fire staff becomes a short crimson-golden spear. Immortal killer move golden sun spear finally activates. Zhao Pu praises the spear’s restrained temperature and radiance, expecting a terrifying burst once it unleashes.

Zhao Lian Yun throws the golden sun spear. It cannot lock onto the target, but it is extremely fast. It brushes past Zhao Pu, pierces the hall, and explodes outside into a boundless heat wave. Dazzling golden light and flames form a small sun-like sphere that soon disappears. She has little real battle experience, and wasting this valuable advantage sharply drops her morale.
